risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified operating data, but highlights persistent macroeconomic, supply-chain, inflationary, foreign-exchange, and segment-specific pressures. Fiscal 2024 expectations of flat sales and lower net income, combined with higher costs and program roll-offs, indicate a cautious negative risk outlook. Standard forward-looking disclaimers and management-estimate language limit certainty around projections and impairment assessments.
